requirement_text: The FTPP system shall be two fault tolerant for any two non-simultaneous hardware faults through out all phases of the X-38 mission (i.e., from power on to power off, without degradation).
requirement_text_raw: The FTPP system shall (3.1.17) be two fault tolerant for any two non-simultaneous hardware faults through out all phases of the X-38 mission (i.e., from power on to power off, without degradation).
user_story: As a mission manager, I want the FTPP system to be two fault tolerant for any two non-simultaneous hardware faults during all phases of the X-38 mission without degradation, so that the mission continues after faults.
technical_task: Design the FTPP system to tolerate any two non-simultaneous hardware faults, from power on to power off, without degradation.
acceptance_criteria: Given a first hardware fault at any phase of the X-38 mission, when it occurs, then the FTPP system continues without degradation.
Given a second hardware fault that does not occur at the same time as the first, when it occurs, then the FTPP system still operates without degradation.
rationale: Role assumed: mission manager.

requirement_text: The user shall be able to manage Subjects.
user_story: As a user, I want to manage Subjects, so that I can keep them up to date.
technical_task: Provide management functions for Subjects.
acceptance_criteria: Given a Subject, when the user manages it, then the change is saved.
Given the list of Subjects, when the user opens it, then the Subjects are shown.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The management actions are not listed.

requirement_text: Only registered realtors shall be able to access the system.
requirement_text_raw: Only registered realtors shall be able to access the system.'
user_story: As a realtor, I want only registered realtors to access the system, so that the system is limited to genuine users.
technical_task: Restrict system access to registered realtors.
acceptance_criteria: Given a registered realtor, when the realtor logs in, then access is granted.
Given a person who is not a registered realtor, when the person tries to access the system, then access is denied.
rationale: Role stated: realtor.

requirement_text: System shall recommend similar items based on the user's buying pattern.
user_story: As a shopper, I want similar items recommended from my buying pattern, so that I find things I may like.
technical_task: Recommend items similar to those suggested by the user's buying pattern.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user with a buying pattern, when the user opens the recommendations, then similar items are shown.
Given a user with no buying pattern, when the user opens the recommendations, then no pattern-based items are shown.
rationale: Role assumed: shopper. How similarity is defined is not stated.

requirement_text: An HCP chooses Office Visit Reminders and then to identify chronic patients who need an office visit older patients who need a flu shot or any patient who is overdue for an immunization .
requirement_text_raw: An HCP chooses Office Visit Reminders and then to identify chronic patients who need an office visit   older patients who need a flu shot   or any patient who is overdue for an immunization .
user_story: As an HCP, I want to choose Office Visit Reminders to identify chronic patients who need an office visit, older patients who need a flu shot and patients overdue for an immunization, so that I can remind them.
technical_task: Offer an Office Visit Reminders option that identifies chronic patients needing an office visit, older patients needing a flu shot and patients overdue for an immunization.
acceptance_criteria: Given the HCP chooses Office Visit Reminders, when the option is selected, then chronic patients who need an office visit can be identified.
Given the HCP chooses Office Visit Reminders, when the option is selected, then older patients who need a flu shot and patients overdue for an immunization can be identified.
rationale: Role stated: HCP. The age for "older" is not stated.

requirement_text: The solution should conform to Auditable Records to audit all changes to other business rules.
user_story: As an auditor, I want all changes to other business rules audited, so that rule changes can be traced.
technical_task: Record an audit entry for every change to business rules other than those already covered, following Auditable Records.
acceptance_criteria: Given a change to a business rule, when the change is saved, then an auditable record of the change is created.
Given the audit records, when an auditor opens them, then the changes to business rules can be found.
rationale: Role assumed: auditor. "Other business rules" refers to rules covered elsewhere.

requirement_text: Recycling facility shall communicate directly with site admin to address any issues or concerns.
user_story: As a recycling facility operator, I want to communicate directly with the site admin about issues or concerns, so that problems are resolved.
technical_task: Provide a direct communication channel between the recycling facility and the site admin.
acceptance_criteria: Given a recycling facility with an issue, when it contacts the site admin, then the message reaches the site admin directly.
Given a message from the site admin, when it is sent to the recycling facility, then the facility receives it.
rationale: Role stated: recycling facility and site admin. The channel type is not specified.

requirement_text: System shall generate weekly rosters for employees (administrator function).
user_story: As an administrator, I want to generate weekly rosters for employees, so that everyone knows their shifts.
technical_task: Add an administrator function that generates a weekly roster for employees.
acceptance_criteria: Given employees, when the administrator generates the roster for a week, then a weekly roster is produced.
Given a generated weekly roster, when an employee views it, then it shows that employee's assignments.
rationale: Role stated: administrator.

requirement_text: Users shall input a unique username.
user_story: As a new user, I want to input a unique username, so that I can be identified.
technical_task: Require a username that is not used by any other user.
acceptance_criteria: Given a username that no other user has, when the user inputs it, then it is accepted.
Given a username that already exists, when the user inputs it, then it is rejected.
rationale: Role assumed: new user. The second criterion follows from "unique".

requirement_text: HEC rules shall be implemented while creating the system.
rationale: "HEC rules" are referenced but not defined.
clarification_questions: What are the HEC rules and where are they defined?
How is conformity to them verified?

requirement_text: Increased RAM shall improve the software's ability to handle complex projects, multiple layers, and large file sizes.
user_story: As a designer, I want more RAM to improve the software's ability to handle complex projects, multiple layers and large files, so that I can work on bigger projects.
technical_task: Make the software use added RAM to handle complex projects, multiple layers and large file sizes better.
acceptance_criteria: Given a computer with more RAM, when a complex project is opened, then the software handles it better than with less RAM.
Given a project with multiple layers or a large file, when more RAM is available, then the software handles it better.
rationale: Role assumed: designer. "Improve" is relative; no target is given.

requirement_text: System shall verify the user's social media account details and share the video link.
user_story: As a user, I want my social media account details verified and the video link shared, so that my video is posted.
technical_task: Verify the user's social media account details and then share the video link.
acceptance_criteria: Given valid social media account details, when the user shares a video, then the details are verified and the video link is shared.
Given invalid account details, when the user shares a video, then the link is not shared.
rationale: Role assumed: user.

requirement_text: The user shall be able to choose a restaurant type from a list and see the results on a map.
user_story: As a diner, I want to choose a restaurant type from a list and see results on a map, so that I find places nearby.
technical_task: Provide a list of restaurant types and show matching restaurants on a map.
acceptance_criteria: Given a list of restaurant types, when the user chooses one, then the results are shown.
Given the results, when they are displayed, then they appear on a map.
rationale: Role assumed: diner.

requirement_text: The system shall be designed for extensibility, maintainability, and open-source release.
rationale: "Extensibility" and "maintainability" are not measurable and the release is not described.
clarification_questions: What makes the design extensible and maintainable in testable terms?
What must be done for the open-source release (license, repository)?

requirement_text: Communication services shall detect a babbling NE or ICP within 20 milliseconds of the receipt of the first erroneous packet.
requirement_text_raw: Communication services shall [SRS235] detect a babbling NE or ICP within 20 milliseconds of the receipt of the first erroneous packet.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want communication services to detect a babbling NE or ICP within 20 milliseconds of the first erroneous packet, so that a faulty unit is isolated quickly.
technical_task: Detect a babbling NE or ICP within 20 milliseconds after the first erroneous packet is received.
acceptance_criteria: Given an NE or ICP sends erroneous packets, when the first erroneous packet is received, then communication services detect it as babbling within 20 milliseconds.
Given detection takes longer than 20 milliseconds, when it is measured, then the requirement is not met.
rationale: Role assumed: systems engineer.

requirement_text: Administrator shall be able to manage queries regarding videos and respond to user queries.
user_story: As an administrator, I want to manage queries about videos and respond to users, so that users get answers.
technical_task: Provide an administrator view to manage video queries and send responses to users.
acceptance_criteria: Given queries about videos, when the administrator opens the list, then the queries are shown.
Given a query, when the administrator responds, then the response is sent to the user.
rationale: Role stated: administrator.

requirement_text: 100% of customers will be able to receive automatic software updates transmitted to the installed product.
user_story: As a customer, I want automatic software updates sent to my installed product, so that it stays current.
technical_task: Deliver software updates automatically to every installed product so that 100% of customers can receive them.
acceptance_criteria: Given an installed product, when an update is released, then it is transmitted to the product automatically.
Given all customers, when an update is released, then 100% of them can receive it.
rationale: Role assumed: customer.

requirement_text: If the torque actuator implements a lower break torque than the break torque request because the [transmission] is not closed then the torque actuator must send this information (`` stop break torque '').
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the torque actuator to report "stop break torque" when it applies a lower break torque than requested because the transmission is not closed, so that the limitation is known.
technical_task: Send the information "stop break torque" from the torque actuator whenever it implements a lower break torque than requested because the transmission is not closed.
acceptance_criteria: Given the transmission is not closed and the torque actuator implements a lower break torque than requested, when this happens, then it sends "stop break torque".
Given the torque actuator implements the requested break torque, when this happens, then "stop break torque" is not sent.
rationale: Role assumed: systems engineer.

requirement_text: System shall maintain an unalterable audit trail capturing actions taken on critical entities, users initiating actions, and date/time of events.
user_story: As an auditor, I want an unalterable audit trail of actions on critical entities, the users who initiated them and the date and time, so that activity can be reviewed.
technical_task: Maintain a tamper-proof audit trail recording actions on critical entities, the initiating users and the date and time of each event.
acceptance_criteria: Given an action on a critical entity, when it is performed, then the audit trail records the action, the initiating user and the date and time.
Given an entry in the audit trail, when someone tries to change it, then the change is not allowed.
rationale: Role assumed: auditor.

requirement_text: As a minimum the TCS LOS data terminal control modes shall include acquisition, autotrack, search,manual point, omni directional, as well as directional modes of operation, if applicable to the selected data link.
user_story: As an operator, I want the TCS LOS data terminal control modes to include acquisition, autotrack, search, manual point, omni directional and directional modes, so that I can control the terminal in each.
technical_task: Provide at least the control modes acquisition, autotrack, search, manual point, omni directional and directional in the TCS LOS data terminal control, where applicable to the selected data link.
acceptance_criteria: Given a selected data link for which the modes apply, when the operator opens the control modes, then acquisition, autotrack, search, manual point, omni directional and directional modes are available.
Given a selected data link for which a mode does not apply, when the operator opens the control modes, then that mode need not be offered.
rationale: Role assumed: operator. "As a minimum" means more modes may exist.

requirement_text: The administrator will store (1) the National Drug Code (The National Drug Code (NDC) is a universal product identifier used in the United States for drugs intended for human use.
rationale: The sentence is cut off after item (1) and the parenthesis is never closed.
clarification_questions: What does the administrator store besides the National Drug Code (item (1))?
What is the complete sentence, since the parenthesis is not closed?

requirement_text: System shall maintain a database to store user progress for a seamless gaming experience across sessions.
user_story: As a player, I want my progress stored in a database, so that my game continues across sessions.
technical_task: Store each user's progress in a database and restore it in later sessions.
acceptance_criteria: Given a player makes progress, when the session ends, then the progress is saved in the database.
Given a player returns in a new session, when the game starts, then the saved progress is restored.
rationale: Role assumed: player. "Seamless" is read as continuing from the saved state.

requirement_text: A customer shall be able to add a wildcard special dietary requirement to an order in the case that their requirement is not represented by the system.
requirement_text_raw: A customer shall be able to add a wildcard special dietary requirement to an  order in the case that their requirement is not represented by the system.
user_story: As a customer, I want to add a wildcard special dietary requirement to an order when mine isn't listed, so that my need is still passed on.
technical_task: Offer a free-text special dietary requirement on an order for cases the system's listed requirements do not cover.
acceptance_criteria: Given a dietary requirement that is not represented by the system, when the customer adds a wildcard requirement, then it is attached to the order.
Given an order with a wildcard dietary requirement, when it is viewed, then the requirement is shown.
rationale: Role assumed: customer. "Wildcard" is read as free text.

requirement_text: The system shall encrypt messages but cannot guarantee confidentiality due to potential decryption by unauthorized parties.
rationale: The sentence says messages are encrypted but denies any confidentiality guarantee, so the required outcome is contradictory.
clarification_questions: Is the system required to guarantee confidentiality or not?
What level of protection must the encryption provide?

requirement_text: User shall be able to process data, reloading if necessary, and accurately handle attributes for recommendations.
user_story: As a user, I want to process data, reload it if necessary and have attributes handled accurately for recommendations, so that recommendations are correct.
technical_task: Allow data processing with a reload option and ensure attributes used for recommendations are handled correctly.
acceptance_criteria: Given data to process, when the user processes it, then it is processed.
Given data that needs reloading, when the user reloads it, then the data is reloaded and the attributes for recommendations are handled accurately.
rationale: Role assumed: user. Which attributes are used is not stated.

requirement_text: The TCS shall notify the operator of all discrepancies found during the mission plan check as well as indicate successful completion of the mission plan check.
user_story: As an operator, I want the TCS to notify me of all discrepancies found in the mission plan check and indicate when it completes successfully, so that I know the plan is valid.
technical_task: Report every discrepancy found during the mission plan check to the operator and show an indication when the check completes successfully.
acceptance_criteria: Given discrepancies are found during the mission plan check, when the check ends, then the operator is notified of all of them.
Given the mission plan check completes without discrepancies, when it ends, then a successful completion is indicated.
rationale: Role assumed: operator.

requirement_text: After CAN initialization the duration since the contactors were opened shall be sent to the energy management at least for 200 milliseconds even if in the meantime the contactors are closed.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the time since the contactors were opened sent to the energy management for at least 200 milliseconds after CAN initialization, even if the contactors close meanwhile, so that energy management sees the event.
technical_task: After CAN initialization, send the duration since the contactors were opened to the energy management for at least 200 milliseconds, regardless of the contactors being closed in the meantime.
acceptance_criteria: Given CAN initialization has completed, when the contactors were opened, then the duration since they were opened is sent to the energy management for at least 200 milliseconds.
Given the contactors are closed during that time, when the 200 milliseconds have not yet passed, then the duration is still sent.
rationale: Role assumed: systems engineer.

requirement_text: The system shall have a user-friendly and intuitive interface.
rationale: "User-friendly" and "intuitive" are subjective.
clarification_questions: What makes an interface "user-friendly" and "intuitive" in measurable terms?
Which user group should it be tested with?

requirement_text: System shall ensure protection against various types of failures, damage, or harm, including physical, social, financial, and psychological.
rationale: "Various types of failures, damage, or harm" including "social" and "psychological" are not defined or measurable.
clarification_questions: Which failures, damage and harm must be protected against?
How can protection against social and psychological harm be tested?

requirement_text: The system shall accept user input for origin and destination stations.
user_story: As a traveler, I want to enter the origin and destination stations, so that I can look up my journey.
technical_task: Provide input fields for origin and destination stations.
acceptance_criteria: Given the search screen, when the user enters an origin and a destination station, then the input is accepted.
Given the search screen, when the user leaves a station empty, then the user is asked to enter it.
rationale: Role assumed: traveler. The second criterion is an assumption.

requirement_text: A row for showing the message subject (now preceded by "RE:") the name of the recipient and the timestamp is then visible in the patient or representative's message outbox.
requirement_text_raw: A row for showing the message subject (now preceded by "RE:")  the name of the recipient  and the timestamp is then visible in the patient or representative's message outbox.
user_story: As a patient, I want my sent message to appear in my outbox as a row with the subject preceded by "RE:", the recipient name and the timestamp, so that I can check what I sent.
technical_task: Show a row in the outbox with the message subject (now preceded by "RE:"), the recipient's name and the timestamp.
acceptance_criteria: Given a message has been sent, when the outbox is displayed, then a row shows the message subject preceded by "RE:".
Given a row in the outbox, when it is displayed, then it shows the name of the recipient and the timestamp.
rationale: Role assumed: patient or representative, as stated. The "RE:" prefix follows the existing behaviour.

requirement_text: System shall ensure security and privacy of log book entries and attached files.
user_story: As a user, I want log book entries and attached files kept secure and private, so that others cannot read them.
technical_task: Protect log book entries and their attached files with access control and privacy measures.
acceptance_criteria: Given a log book entry, when an unauthorized user tries to open it, then access is denied.
Given a file attached to a log book entry, when an unauthorized user tries to open it, then access is denied.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The measures are not specified.

requirement_text: The APAF system web server shall be password protected where appropriate to allow only pertinent ASPERA-3 team members access.
user_story: As an ASPERA-3 team member, I want the APAF web server password protected so that only pertinent team members can access it, so that the data stays within the team.
technical_task: Protect the APAF system web server with a password where appropriate, allowing only pertinent ASPERA-3 team members access.
acceptance_criteria: Given an ASPERA-3 team member with the password, when the member opens the APAF web server, then access is granted.
Given a person who is not a pertinent ASPERA-3 team member, when the person opens the APAF web server, then access is denied.
rationale: Role assumed: ASPERA-3 team member. "Where appropriate" is not defined.

requirement_text: A Data Publishing User shall be able to add a dataset in a hidden state.
user_story: As a data publisher, I want to add a dataset in a hidden state, so that it is not visible until I publish it.
technical_task: Allow a dataset to be added with hidden visibility.
acceptance_criteria: Given a new dataset, when the Data Publishing User adds it in a hidden state, then it is saved as hidden.
Given a hidden dataset, when other users browse datasets, then it is not shown to them.
rationale: Role stated: Data Publishing User. The second criterion is an interpretation of "hidden".

requirement_text: User shall have metadata automatically filled from University systems and remembered from previous deposits.
user_story: As a depositor, I want metadata filled in automatically from University systems and remembered from earlier deposits, so that I do not retype it.
technical_task: Prefill deposit metadata from University systems and from the user's previous deposits.
acceptance_criteria: Given a deposit form, when it is opened, then metadata available from University systems is filled in automatically.
Given a user with previous deposits, when a new deposit form is opened, then metadata from previous deposits is filled in.
rationale: Role assumed: depositor.

requirement_text: The system shall allow administrators to add new restaurant types.
user_story: As an administrator, I want to add new restaurant types, so that more kinds of restaurants are listed.
technical_task: Allow administrators to add restaurant types.
acceptance_criteria: Given an administrator, when the administrator adds a new restaurant type, then it is saved.
Given a saved restaurant type, when the type list is shown, then the new type is included.
rationale: Role stated: administrator.

requirement_text: Public Health Agent: A person legally authorized view and respond to reports of adverse events.
rationale: The sentence defines a role and states no system behaviour.
clarification_questions: Is this a definition rather than a requirement?
What must the system do for a Public Health Agent?

requirement_text: With regards to the intended number of users in the Amsterdam pilot, and the projected load scenarios, the intention is for the system to be able to serve 20.000 queries / day (in large part during the 4 peak traffic hours).
user_story: As an operations manager, I want the system to serve 20.000 queries per day, largely during the 4 peak traffic hours, so that the Amsterdam pilot can run at the projected load.
technical_task: Dimension the system to serve 20.000 queries per day, with most of them arriving in the 4 peak traffic hours.
acceptance_criteria: Given a day in the Amsterdam pilot, when 20.000 queries are submitted, then the system serves them.
Given the 4 peak traffic hours, when most of the day's queries arrive, then the system keeps serving them.
rationale: Role assumed: operations manager. "In large part" is not quantified.

requirement_text: If the parking time is longer the calculation has to be stopped.
user_story: As a driver, I want the parking fee calculation to stop when the parking time is longer, so that I am not charged beyond the limit.
technical_task: Stop the calculation when the parking time is longer than the allowed time.
acceptance_criteria: Given the parking time is longer, when the calculation runs, then it is stopped.
Given the parking time is not longer, when the calculation runs, then it is not stopped.
rationale: Role assumed: driver. "Longer" refers to a limit not given in the sentence.

requirement_text: System shall provide documentation and support resources for users to effectively utilize DMP functionalities.
rationale: "Documentation and support resources" and "effectively" are not specified.
clarification_questions: What documentation and support resources are required?
How is effective use of DMP functionalities measured?

requirement_text: System shall display available astrologers for interaction based on user input.
user_story: As a user, I want to see available astrologers based on my input, so that I can choose one to talk to.
technical_task: Display the astrologers who are available and match the user's input.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user's input, when the user searches, then available astrologers matching it are displayed.
Given an astrologer who is not available, when the user searches, then the astrologer is not displayed.
rationale: Role assumed: user.

requirement_text: The Configuration Table shall be exchanged and voted into the newly recovered NE.
requirement_text_raw: The Configuration Table shall (3.2.2.4.7) be exchanged and voted into the newly recovered NE.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the Configuration Table exchanged and voted into the newly recovered NE, so that the NE has the correct configuration.
technical_task: Exchange the Configuration Table with the newly recovered NE and vote it into that NE.
acceptance_criteria: Given an NE has just been recovered, when the Configuration Table is exchanged, then it is delivered to that NE.
Given the Configuration Table has been exchanged, when it is voted, then it is voted into the newly recovered NE.
rationale: Role assumed: systems engineer.

requirement_text: A surface computer shall provide a customer with all customer system functionality.
requirement_text_raw: A surface computer shall provide a customer with all customer system  functionality.
user_story: As a customer, I want a surface computer to provide all customer system functionality, so that I can use the full system there.
technical_task: Make every customer system function available on the surface computer.
acceptance_criteria: Given a customer system function, when the customer uses the surface computer, then the function is available.
Given the full set of customer system functions, when they are compared with the surface computer, then none is missing.
rationale: Role stated: customer.

requirement_text: User shall include the code of a dataset type in their app artifact and create a dataset of that type when deploying the app.
user_story: As an app developer, I want to include the code of a dataset type in my app artifact and create a dataset of that type on deploy, so that the app sets up its data.
technical_task: Support including a dataset type's code in an app artifact and creating a dataset of that type at deployment.
acceptance_criteria: Given an app artifact containing the code of a dataset type, when the app is deployed, then a dataset of that type is created.
Given an app artifact without a dataset type, when the app is deployed, then no dataset is created.
rationale: Role assumed: app developer; the requirement says user.

requirement_text: User shall be able to cancel a reservation.
user_story: As a customer, I want to cancel a reservation, so that I can free it if my plans change.
technical_task: Provide a cancel function for reservations.
acceptance_criteria: Given an existing reservation, when the user cancels it, then the reservation is cancelled.
Given a cancelled reservation, when the user views their reservations, then it is no longer active.
rationale: Role assumed: customer.

requirement_text: The details of the interface between the rotor hub and the rotor segments (laminations / stack) shall be designed by the contractor.
user_story: As a project manager, I want the contractor to design the interface between the rotor hub and the rotor segments, so that the contractor is responsible for it.
technical_task: Assign the design of the interface between the rotor hub and the rotor segments (laminations / stack) to the contractor.
acceptance_criteria: Given the interface between the rotor hub and the rotor segments, when the design is delivered, then it was designed by the contractor.
Given the design, when it is reviewed, then it covers the rotor hub and the rotor segments (laminations / stack).
rationale: Role assumed: project manager.

requirement_text: User shall benefit from a simple UI design with easily navigable screens and features, facilitating user interaction and understanding.
rationale: "Simple", "easily navigable" and "understanding" are subjective.
clarification_questions: What makes a UI "simple" and "easily navigable" in measurable terms?
How is user understanding measured?

requirement_text: For details of digital video interfaces see "System Specification Telematic5STAR1 HU High LVDS Physical Layer" .
requirement_text_raw: For details of digital video interfaces see "System Specification Telematic5STAR1 HU High LVDS Physical Layer" [RD3615].
rationale: The sentence only points to another specification.
clarification_questions: What does the referenced LVDS Physical Layer specification require?
Is the referenced specification part of this requirement?

requirement_text: For acceptance testing, the flight NE shall (3.2.3.1.3.12.1.3) meet the following temperature requirement while operating, 32 F to 132 F (0 C to 55.6 C) at the card edge.
user_story: As a test engineer, I want the flight NE to operate at 32 F to 132 F (0 C to 55.6 C) at the card edge during acceptance testing, so that it is proven in that range.
technical_task: Verify in acceptance testing that the flight NE operates with a card edge temperature from 32 F to 132 F (0 C to 55.6 C).
acceptance_criteria: Given the card edge is at 32 F (0 C), when the flight NE is operated during acceptance testing, then it operates.
Given the card edge is at 132 F (55.6 C), when the flight NE is operated during acceptance testing, then it operates.
rationale: Role assumed: test engineer.

requirement_text: System shall be able to maintain and display subject details including code, name, type, semester, and credits.
user_story: As a teacher, I want to maintain and display subject details including code, name, type, semester and credits, so that subjects are described consistently.
technical_task: Store and display subject details with code, name, type, semester and credits.
acceptance_criteria: Given a subject, when the user enters its code, name, type, semester and credits, then they are saved.
Given a saved subject, when it is displayed, then its code, name, type, semester and credits are shown.
rationale: Role assumed: teacher.
